extraction.Name: Louise Ruleau now Cottier
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, but took it on the advice of the Superintendent and Farmer who told her that if she did not take it and pay the taxes that the land would be sold to pay them
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold her land to Provost & Emily of Gordon, Nebr. for $2240.00
extraction.Buyer: Provost & Emily of Gordon, Nebr. for $2240.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: took it on the advice of the Superintendent and Farmer who told her that if she did not take it and pay the taxes that the land would be sold to pay them
extraction.Occupation/Income: husband supports her by common labor, earning about $500.00 a year, both husband and wife working
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in good health; has no land, no home and lives on the allotment of her husband; has 3 children depending on her for support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since she received her patent; document sworn November 26, 1928; county of Shannon, State of South Dakota
